failures.what: Assumptions are not properly cited or verified

failures.what: OEM status is not properly formatted
failures.why: The oem_status field is set to 'OEM limits required; compliance not determined', but this is not a valid format. The correct format is 'OEM limits required; compliance not determined' as specified in the acceptance criteria.
